description: Defensive tooling closes the gap for a whole class of attack – automated patching at the speed vulnerabilities are found, or detection that catches swarm behaviour rather than signatures – and the offence-defence balance visibly shifts back for the first time in years.

An open-weight release lands within months of the closed frontier rather than a year. It is downloaded hundreds of thousands of times in the first week, and whatever capability it carries is now on private hardware permanently and beyond recall. `openweight_capability` moves to within 5–10 points of `ai_capability` at a stroke.

Preliminary data from Germany, France, and the Netherlands show accelerating displacement in administrative, legal support, and junior engineering roles, with AI systems now handling end-to-end tasks previously requiring human oversight. Unions file coordinated grievances, and national media begin referring to a 'silent wave' of job erosion. This is not yet a crisis, but it marks a shift from isolated cases to structural pressure.
